name: Sheshai
title: Anakite Giant in Hebron
summary: Sheshai was one of the three Anakite giants living in Hebron when the Israelites arrived in Canaan. He was a descendant of Anak, and his name is mentioned among the fearsome giants reported by the spies. Sheshai was eventually driven out by Caleb, who conquered Hebron.

keyEvents.title: The Spies See the Giants
keyEvents.description: When Moses sent twelve spies into the land of Canaan, they came to Hebron where Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, descendants of Anak, lived. The spies reported that they felt like grasshoppers compared to the giants.

keyEvents.title: The People's Fear of the Giants
keyEvents.description: The report about Sheshai and the other Anakites caused great fear among the Israelites, and the people refused to enter the promised land. This led God to condemn that generation to wander in the wilderness for forty years.

keyEvents.title: Caleb Promises to Conquer Hebron
keyEvents.description: Caleb was one of the two spies who trusted in God, and he asked to receive Hebron as his inheritance, even though giants lived there.

keyEvents.title: Caleb drives out the three sons of Anak
keyEvents.description: Caleb drove Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the three sons of Anak, out of Hebron and captured the city as his inheritance in the promised land.

keyEvents.title: The tribe of Judah defeats the Anakites
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Judah marched against Hebron and defeated Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai. This confirmed God's promise that the Israelites would overcome the giants in Canaan.
